fields.help_en:
The unique URI of the file. Used to record the unique file path. Supports file paths in OSS and NAS.
<details>
<summary>OSS</summary>
oss://${bucket}/${path}
</details>
<details>
<summary>NAS</summary>
nas://${fileSystemId}/${path}
</details>
fields.help_zh:
文件唯一URI。用于记录文件唯一路径。支持OSS、NAS下的文件路径。
<details>
<summary>OSS</summary>
oss://${bucket}/${path}
</details>
<details>
<summary>NAS</summary>
nas://${fileSystemId}/${path}
</details>
